warnings.message: Pipenv: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Pipenv 2026.10.4, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Use Pipenv 2026.10.4 or a recent version wherever the project is installed; Pipenv has no setting that pins its version in the project

warnings.message: Pipenv: no setting exempts packages from cool-down-period, so the Python packages in cooldown.exclude wait like every other package
warnings.fix: Nothing to set for Pipenv, which delays these packages too; keep them in cooldown.exclude for the other tools, or remove them if they can wait

warnings.message: Pipenv: the Pipfile has no setting that forbids building packages from source, so installScripts "deny" is not written
warnings.fix: Set PIP_ONLY_BINARY=:all: where Pipenv installs packages (CI, Dockerfile); Pipenv passes it on to pip

warnings.message: Pipenv has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Pipenv has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile
